summary: This note is a short encyclopedic entry on Voshmgir District, a district (bakhsh) in Aqqala County, Golestan Province, Iran. It gives the 2006 census population and family count, names its one city, and lists its two rural districts.
one_line: Voshmgir District is an administrative district in Aqqala County, Golestan Province, Iran, with one city and two rural districts.
key_facts: Voshmgir District is a district (bakhsh) in Aqqala County, Golestan Province, Iran.
At the 2006 census, the population of Voshmgir District was 25,149.
At the 2006 census, Voshmgir District had 5,266 families.
Voshmgir District has one city, Anbar Olum.
Voshmgir District has two rural districts (dehestan).
One rural district of Voshmgir District is Mazraeh-ye Jonubi Rural District.
The other rural district of Voshmgir District is Mazraeh-ye Shomali Rural District.
